 """Orders and their life cycle. See docs/order-states.md."""
 
+from .errors import ShopError
 from .inventory import Inventory
 
 NEW = "NEW"
@@ -46,3 +47,27 @@ class Order:
 
     def deliver(self) -> None:
         self._transition((SHIPPED,), DELIVERED)
+
+    def cancel(self) -> None:
+        """Cancel an unshipped order and release its reserved stock."""
+        if self.state == CANCELLED:
+            return
+        if self.state not in (NEW, PAID):
+            raise ShopError(f"cannot cancel an order in state {self.state}")
+
+        # Check every line before releasing any stock so a failed cancellation
+        # cannot leave only part of the order released.
+        for sku, qty in self.lines.items():
+            if qty <= 0:
+                raise ShopError("qty must be positive")
+            if qty > self.inventory.reserved(sku):
+                raise ShopError(
+                    f"only {self.inventory.reserved(sku)} of {sku} reserved"
+                )
+
+        was_paid = self.state == PAID
+        for sku, qty in self.lines.items():
+            self.inventory.release(sku, qty)
+        self.state = CANCELLED
+        if was_paid:
+            self.refund_due = True
